items.name: Washington Championship 2020
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. Please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WashingtonChampionship2020#10692-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

For more information about cubing in the Pacific Northwest, check out the [PNW website](https://www.pnwcubing.com)!
